title: CERF allocation report: Bangladesh, anticipatory action for monsoon floods (2020)
summary: Final report on the use of funds and results of CERF allocation 20-RR-BGD-44022 (US$5.19 million), released ahead of the July 2020 Jamuna floods.

title: CERF allocation report: Somalia, anticipatory action against food insecurity (2020)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 20-RR-SOM-44036 (US$14.99 million), the pilot activation of the Somalia anticipatory action framework in June 2020.

title: CERF allocation report: Somalia, anticipatory action for drought (2021)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 21-RR-SOM-47081 (US$20 million), the 2021 drought activation of the Somalia framework.

title: CERF allocation report: Ethiopia, anticipatory action for drought (2020-21)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 20-RR-ETH-46461, the drought activation of the Ethiopia anticipatory action framework. Hosted by ALNAP; no copy found on cerf.un.org.

title: CERF allocation report: Nepal, anticipatory action for floods (2021)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 21-RR-NPL-48553: US$3.2 million disbursed in eastern Nepal after the readiness trigger of 13 August 2021; the unused balance was returned.

title: CERF allocation report: Nepal, anticipatory action for floods (2022)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 22-RR-NPL-53977 (US$3.19 million), released when the Karnali flood trigger was met in October 2022.

title: CERF allocation report: Niger, anticipatory action for drought (2022)
summary: Final report (in French) on CERF allocation 22-RR-NER-54991, the 2022 pilot activation of the Niger drought framework.

title: CERF allocation report: South Sudan, anticipatory action for floods (2022)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 22-RR-SSD-52855 (US$14.99 million), early action ahead of the projected 2022 floods.

title: CERF allocation report: Democratic Republic of the Congo, anticipatory action for cholera (2023)
summary: Final report (in French) on CERF allocation 23-RR-COD-59790, anticipatory action against cholera in eastern DRC in 2023.

title: CERF allocation report: Nepal, anticipatory action for floods (2024)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation 24-RR-NPL-65081 (US$3.41 million), released when the Koshi basin framework was activated on 29 September 2024.

title: CERF allocation report: Niger, anticipatory action for floods (2024)
summary: Final report on CERF allocation CERF-NER-24-RR-1398 (US$5.0 million), anticipatory action ahead of the 2024 floods.
